overview: November combines agentic LLM workflows for simulation calibration, observing and literature extraction with simulation-based inference and generative surrogates for cosmology, gravitational waves, MHD turbulence and stellar structure. Euclid DR1 produces a 15,072-candidate strong-lens catalogue from a 68-million-object CNN and citizen-science search. Cross-survey benchmarks (COSMIO, FAIR Universe weak lensing) and large catalogues (Survey of Surveys DR3, 10.13 million stars) target imputation, uncertainty and homogenisation. Gravitational-wave papers add waveform emulators, 3G BNS early warning, LISA glitch classification and EMRI inference.
